_doc: Khuôn Reels (docs/specs/social-reels-templates.md): Ama/Carlos đọc mẫu tiếng Anh ≤150 wpm, chừa lặng cho người xem đọc theo (repeat), IPA lấy từ kho từ lúc dựng, chữ bản địa viết tay (native-qa).

segments.text: Wine, Van, Wait, Vote. Watch my mouth.
Repeat after me. Wine, Van, Wait, Vote.

native.hook: V और W का फ़र्क़ सुनिए
native.caption: हिंदी में v और w लगभग एक जैसे बोले जाते हैं, पर “wine” और “van” अलग शब्द हैं। w में होंठ गोल होते हैं, v में ऊपर के दाँत निचले होंठ को छूते हैं। Ama टीचर का मुँह देखिए और ख़ामोशी में दोहराइए। Lexkite ऐप में अभ्यास कीजिए।

en.hook: Hear the difference between V and W
en.caption: In Hindi v and w sound almost the same, but “wine” and “van” are different words. For w your lips are round; for v your top teeth touch your lower lip. Watch teacher Ama’s mouth and repeat in the pause. Practice in the Lexkite app.
